messages:
acme-cs: Hey support — after upgrading to @redwood/sdk@0.23 our production app started getting 404s to /api/v1/chat.create and entered a retry loop, which spiked requests and billing. Repro steps below.
jordan: Sorry to hear — can you paste a short log excerpt and confirm the SDK version? Any request IDs?
acme-cs: log snippet: ```Error: 404 Not Found
    at Request._callback (/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/lib/index.js:345:12)
    at Request.self.callback (/app/node_modules/request/request.js:185:22)
    at Request.emit (events.js:203:15)
```
Also server returned JSON: `\{"error\":\"unknown endpoint chat.create\", \"details\": \"unknown param session_id\"\}`
jordan: Thanks — looks like SDK is still calling `chat.create` and sending `session_id` but API expects `chat.completions` + `chat_session` now. maria, does 0.23 include compatibility shims?
maria: 0.23 should have a mapping shim but i think the published 0.23.0 missed a commit. I can repro locally when I force the API to reject unknown params. What does their package.json show?
acme-cs: package.json shows "@redwood/sdk": "^0.23.0" — they installed and npm resolved to 0.23.0 today. If they pin to 0.22.x the errors stop.
ev an: can you run this and paste the output? `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk/package.json').version)"` also any correlation id from logs (cid=)?
acme-cs: output: `0.23.0`  cid=abc123def - we've got several CI prod worker traces with that id.
maria: confirmed — published 0.23.0 dropped the fallback. I'll open a patch PR to restore the shim and add a mapping layer for `session_id`->`chat_session`. ETA ~30m to publish 0.23.1. Workaround: pin to `@redwood/sdk@0.22.7`.
liz-sre: FYI this is triggering aggressive client retries; gateway seeing 5x normal QPS from a single org. Recommend we throttle client retries for 4xx and add a billing guard for sudden spikes due to release regressions.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Draft release created: v0.23.1 (includes shim + param mapping) — release id 4321.
jordan: Please also create a billing escalation for acme (cc finance) — they saw ~3x token use this morning from retries.
acme-cs: rolling back to pinned 0.22.7 in prod now. Please ping when 0.23.1 is live so we can upgrade.
maria: Published 0.23.1 at 1725554600. Release notes: "restore chat.create compatibility shim; map legacy `session_id` to `chat_session`; add CI test to prevent regression". Please `npm install @redwood/sdk@0.23.1` and recheck.
acme-cs: verified after install — calls now go to `/api/v1/chat.completions`, unknown param error gone, no retry loop. Thanks :thumbsup:
jordan: Created internal billing ticket #BILL-872 and looped in finance. Closing this thread once customer confirms no further anomalies.
__notes: Generated Slack thread: TypeScript SDK 0.23 missing compatibility shim -> 404s, retries, billing spike. Contains logs, repro steps, workaround, patch + release.
